meta.title: Levain Kit — multilingual bakery & patisserie website templates
meta.desc: Three interactive, responsive website templates for artisan bakeries and patisseries, shipped in English, French, Spanish and Arabic.

hero.title: Bread that keeps
hero.lead: Four flours, one starter, twenty-six hours of patience. Baked twice a day, sold out by seven — come early or reserve online.

specialties.title: What we are known for
specialties.lead: A short menu, kept honest. Everything on the counter was shaped by hand this morning.
specialties.c1d: Rye and wheat levain, 26-hour cold ferment, blistered crust that sings when it cools.
specialties.c2d: Charentes-Poitou butter, 27 laminated layers, proofed overnight so the crumb stays open.
specialties.c3d: Fruit tarts, éclairs and celebration cakes — ordered Thursday, ready Saturday.

menu.title: Today at the counter
menu.lead: Live prices, live stock. Add to your basket and we will have the bag ready at the counter.
menu.note: Prices include local tax. Last basket taken 30 minutes before closing.

batch.title: Out of the oven in
batch.lead: Real countdown to the next bake, straight from our oven log.

story.title: Three generations, one stubborn starter
story.lead: Marcel started with a borrowed oven in 1991. His granddaughter runs it today and the levain — begun in 1974 — still gets fed twice a day.
story.p1: We mill in small batches, ferment cold and refuse to rush. If a dough is not ready, the shelf stays half empty and we say so at the counter.
story.p2: Everything is written twice: once on the slate behind the till, once here — in your language, with the same prices.
story.quote: “Good bread is a promise kept every morning.”

services.title: More than a bakery
services.lead: Three things we do besides baking, all bookable from this page.
services.workshops.d: Saturdays, 6 people max. Take your own starter home at the end of the session.
services.weddings.d: Cake tables, salés platters and late-night brioche for up to 200 guests.
services.wholesale.d: Daily delivery to 40 neighbourhood tables. Frozen par-baked options available.

gallery.title: Inside the bakehouse
gallery.lead: Shot on a phone, at 4 a.m., by whoever was on shift.

testimonials.title: What the street says
testimonials.lead: Reviews from locals, walkers and one very persistent food blogger.
testimonials.v1.text: I moved to another city and still ask friends to photograph the board so I know what to order when I visit. The crumb is unreal.
testimonials.v1.name: Camille R.
testimonials.v2.text: Ordered a cake on the site at 21:47, it was waiting for me at 07:00 with my name on the bag. That is service.
testimonials.v2.name: Julien B.
testimonials.v3.text: The croissant shatters on the plate exactly like it should. I checked the price twice because I did not believe it.
testimonials.v3.name: Ana S.
testimonials.v4.text: Half the staff speak English, the website speaks my language and the rye loaf lasts a week. Nothing to complain about.
testimonials.v4.name: Léo & Beth

hours.title: Find the shop
hours.lead: Corner of the market square. Two tables outside when the weather behaves.
hours.transit: Metro A — Hôtel de Ville, 3 min on foot
hours.holiday: Closed 1 May, 25 Dec, 1 Jan. First week of August: mornings only.

faq.title: Questions we get at the till
faq.f1.q: Can I reserve bread the night before?
faq.f1.a: Yes. Use the pre-order form or send a message before 21:00. Anything reserved is kept until one hour after closing.
faq.f2.a: Bicycle delivery inside 3 km on Tuesdays to Saturdays, free over €25, otherwise €3.50.
faq.f3.a: A buckwheat and millet loaf on Saturdays only, baked in a separate room at the end of the day.
faq.f4.q: Do you take orders for large events?
faq.f4.a: With 10 days notice. We handle cake tables, salés platters and late-night brioche up to 200 guests.
faq.f5.q: Which languages does this site speak?
faq.f5.a: English, French, Spanish and Arabic — including full right-to-left layout. The switcher keeps your choice between visits.

basket.title: Your basket
basket.empty: Empty for now. The menu is right behind you.
basket.note: Nothing is charged online. We get paid at the till.

footer.blurb: Independent bakehouse, wood-fired oven, three bakes a day and a website that finally speaks the neighbourhood's languages.
footer.newsletter: One message a month: what is baking, what is new.
footer.newsletterOk: Thank you — see you at the counter.

hub.title: Templates for bakers who also speak French
hub.lead: A production-ready website kit for artisan bakeries and patisseries: three design systems, one interactive engine, four languages (English, French, Spanish, Arabic) and a pre-order basket — no framework, no build lock-in.
hub.galleryLead: Same data, same components, three completely different design systems. Ship any of them in an afternoon.
hub.t.artisan.d: Dark warm palette, oversized serif, split hero with a live open/closed badge. Made for villages, markets and third-wave sourdough.
hub.t.patisserie.d: Ivory and blush, editorial hero, pastry list that reads like a menu card. Built for salons de thé, wedding cakes and gift boxes.
hub.t.moderno.d: Terracotta and olive, big centred type, card menu with sticky filter bar. Built for neighbourhood panaderías with heavy foot traffic.
hub.featLead: Features a bakery actually asks for, written without a framework so the file stays editable for the next ten years.
hub.f1d: English, French, Spanish and Arabic dictionaries, 100% key parity, validated at build time.
hub.f2d: One attribute flips the whole layout: logical CSS properties, mirrored icons, Arabic numerals and Arabic plural rules.
hub.f3d: Add, edit quantities, remember it in localStorage, hand the order over by WhatsApp or email. Nothing charged, nothing to maintain.
hub.f4d: “Next bake in 42 min” computed from the bake log, updated every second, honest about sold-out batches.
hub.f5d: Header badge and hours table read your schedule, your timezone and today's holiday, not a hard-coded string.
hub.f6d: Fluid type with clamp(), touch targets ≥ 44 px, container queries on cards, print sheet for the till.
hub.f7d: Keyboard paths, focus rings, aria-live on basket updates, 4.5:1 contrast, reduced-motion honoured.
hub.f8d: Zero dependencies, ~38 KB of script, system fonts, preloaded hero, works from a file:// folder if you must.
hub.langLead: Every string, date, number, currency and direction is driven by the dictionary below. The choice is remembered per visitor.
hub.langSample: Fresh butter croissant — €2.40 — out of the oven at 06:30
hub.langNote: Numbers and currency are formatted with the browser's Intl API: €2.40 becomes 2,40 € in French, 2,40 € in Spanish and ‏٢٫٤٠ € when Arabic is requested with Arabic numerals.
hub.calcTitle: Price a client site in 20 seconds
hub.calcLead: Pick a template, a package and the options your client needs. The maths matches the price list in docs/PRICING.md.
hub.calcNote: Self-employed rates, ex-VAT. Deposit 40% before work starts, balance at go-live.

hub.pkg.patisserie.d: Four languages including Arabic RTL, custom theme layer, menu CMS, local SEO, 12 months of care.

hub.devTitle: Run it, brand it, ship it
hub.devLead: Four commands between a clone and a client's domain. Everything is plain HTML, CSS and ESM JavaScript.
hub.step1d: Install nothing. The kit has no dependencies at all.
hub.step2d: Edit src/data/site.json for prices, hours and products; edit src/data/locales/*.json for words.
hub.step3d: The generator rebuilds three static templates and inlines the dictionaries.
hub.step4d: Any static host. Netlify, Vercel, GitHub Pages, Cloudflare, a USB stick — it all works.
hub.deployLead: Static files, so hosting is free or nearly free, and the client keeps the whole site in a folder.
hub.deploy.netlify.d: Connect the repo, build command `npm run build`, publish directory `dist`. Free tier is enough for a shop.
hub.deploy.vercel.d: Framework preset “Other”, output `dist`, add a redirect from / to /index.html for clean links.
hub.deploy.github.d: Push `dist` to a gh-pages branch or use Actions. Domain with HTTPS, still free.
hub.deploy.custom.d: Copy the `dist` folder into any web root. No runtime, no database, no PHP.
hub.docsLead: Everything a designer or a client's nephew needs to keep the site fresh.

hub.d6: Resize to 320 px, or zoom to 200%, and check nothing breaks.
